clips.name: rinrin_stop
clips.prompt: A cute chibi baby panda facing right is walking in place, takes one last small step and comes to a gentle stop, then settles into a relaxed standing pose still facing right, holding its paws together in front of its chest. Smooth natural slowdown. It stays in the center of the frame and does not move forward. Pure white background, fixed camera. Same character design as the input image: thick dark brown outline, flat white fur, dark charcoal ears, eye patches, arms and legs, pink cheeks. Clean flat 2D cartoon illustration.
